title: Medium-Sized-Room Humidifier Has All Desirable Features
text:
Medium-Sized-Room Humidifier Has All Desirable Features. UPDATE 3/12/18: After several months of uneventful operation, my humidifier began intermittently leaking badly onto the floor. I finally figured out that the water reservoir in the base, which hydrates the wick, was overfilling. This was happening because the valve on the refillable water tank, which controls the automatic delivery of water as needed during operation, was malfunctioning. This was NOT user error. It is a basic design or manufacturing flaw. Rating changed from 5 stars to 1 star.

This VORNADO ENERGY SMART EVAPORATIVE HUMIDIFIER (EVDC300, with Automatic Shut-off, 1 Gallon Capacity, LED Display) has all the features that I want in a medium-room-size humidifier. First, when it's running in the “Energy Smart” mode (indicated by a green light next to the lighted power button), it turns off automatically when it runs out of water.

Second, it remembers the settings when it's turned off. After you power it off and on again while refilling the tank, you don't have to punch all the buttons again for (1) humidity level, (2) fan speed, and (3) automatic, continuous, or Energy Smart mode.

Third, it has a 1-gallon tank that lasts about 30 hours (when I keep it in Energy Smart mode, on high fan speed, with 60% humidity). The tank is easy to refill, because it has a wide circular top opening, and isn't too heavy when filled with water. The tank has a built-in handle that makes it easy to carry.

Fourth, it has a single wick (a mesh sheet that soaks up water from the tank). This needs to be replaced when it gets hard enough that it won’t wick up water, or when it develops algae or mold. The wick contains an antimicrobial additive, and you can extend the wick’s life by adding a bacteriostatic solution that suppresses algae growth to the water tank. The wick is supposed to last 4-8 weeks; using the algae suppressant, my wicks last at least 12 weeks (in Energy Smart mode). (This model uses [[ASIN:B01J664VSA Vornado EVDC300 wicks (2-pack)]].)

Fifth, the fan turns off when the humidifier sensor determines that the set humidity level has been reached. You can set the humidity at anything from 40 to 60 percent (in 5-point steps). The sensor is an approximation, of course--when my humidifier reads 60%, two other nearby sensors read 46% and 56%. It takes a few days for the room humidity to reach the desired level. (The fan can be manually set to run continuously at extra-high speed, if you want to raise the humidity level fast. If you do this, check the water tank frequently, because with this setting the humidifier won't turn off automatically when it’s out of water.)

Finally, the humidifier has a water tank light that pulses a warning when the water level is low.

features: ENERGY EFFICIENT — Whole room humidity circulation, up to 750 sq. ft. , driven by an Energy Smart DC motor that uses 90% less energy.
INCREASED OUTPUT — One SimpleTank System 1-gallon tank provides up to 3-gallon output every 24 hours and provides for easier refills and cleaning.
CUSTOMIZABLE — Multi-speed fan settings paired with auto humidity control for 40-60% or continuous output.

SUPERIOR SUPPORT — When you choose a Vornado humidifier, you’re investing in superior performance and design that will deliver total satisfaction. If not, we’ll replace it, for 5 years. Supported by a customer service team based in Andover, KS.
Built to meet U. S. voltage requirements. Certified, safety-tested, and warrantied for use only in the U. S.
description: The EVDC300 delivers whole-room humidification driven by an Energy Smart DC motor. With more power than a standard Vornado, it delivers our whole-room humidity circulation using 90% less energy versus a comparable Vornado AC motor-driven humidifier. The minimalistic design features a clear, easy-fill 1-gallon tank that is simple to use and maintain, with a low-water indicator that shows when it’s time to refill. Customizable humidity settings paired with precise auto humidity control allow you to tailor the natural evaporation process, leaving a perfectly humidified space free from the white dust that mist leaves behind. The EVDC300 ensures a comfortable breathing environment with the peace of mind of a 5-year satisfaction and 10-year motor .

IMPORTANT INTERNATIONAL DISCLAIMER: This item is built to meet U.S. voltage requirements and may not function properly when used in conjunction with external devices that alter or convert voltage or frequency of electricity. Improper use or shipping the product outside the U.S. will void all warranties.
